🚀 Hiring: Data Engineer 🚀 
🌍 Location: USA Remote
📌 Contract Type: C2C (Corp-to-Corp) 
What You Will Do:
Pipeline Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and Snowflake.
ETL/ELT Optimization: Build and optimize end-to-end data processes for seamless ingestion, transformation, and reporting.
Legacy & Integration: Develop and maintain data integration solutions utilizing SSIS.
Automation: Write and optimize highly efficient Python scripts for data processing and platform integrations.
Collaboration: Partner with business stakeholders, analysts, and technical teams to translate business needs into data solutions.
Operations & Compliance: Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve performance issues while maintaining top-tier data quality, security, and governance. 
Key Requirements:
Core technical expertise in ADF, Snowflake, and SSIS.
Strong programming foundations in Python for data engineering.
Background in code reviews, technical documentation, and best-practice deployment.
